nodes.description: Public bytes32 Merkle root used to verify ring claim proofs; writable by owner via setMerkleRoot.
Public address of the ERC721 ring collection contract that is queried and transferred from during claims; settable by owner.
Public boolean kill-switch checked at the start of claimRing; toggled by owner via setPaused.
Public mapping(address => bool) tracking whether an address has already claimed a ring.
Private owner address inherited from Ownable; set at construction and mutated by _setOwner.
Constructor initialising merkleRoot and rings and (via Ownable) setting the deployer as owner.
onlyOwner function that replaces the Merkle root used for claim verification.
onlyOwner function that replaces the ERC721 collection address used by claimRing.
onlyOwner function that toggles the pause flag gating claimRing.
Public claim entrypoint: checks pause flag and claim status, verifies Merkle proof for msg.sender, marks the sender claimed, then pulls the NFT via transferFrom.
Ownable view function returning the stored _owner address.
onlyOwner function that transfers ownership to address(0) forever.
onlyOwner function that hands ownership to a non-zero newOwner.
Private helper that writes _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Context helper returning msg.sender; used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Caller-controlled address; used for claim bookkeeping, Merkle leaf derivation and NFT recipient.
External call IERC721(rings).transferFrom(tokenOwner, msg.sender, tokenId) to an attacker-influenceable contract address; reentrancy surface.
External call IERC721(rings).ownerOf(tokenId) to the configured rings contract, returning its claimed token owner.
Constructor bytes32 parameter seeding merkleRoot.
Constructor address parameter seeding rings.
bytes32 parameter of setMerkleRoot assigned to merkleRoot.
address parameter of setRings assigned to rings.
bool parameter of setPaused assigned to paused.
bytes32[] Merkle proof supplied by the caller of claimRing.
Caller-supplied token id of the ring being claimed.
address parameter of transferOwnership forwarded to _setOwner.
Local variable in claimRing holding the result of IERC721(rings).ownerOf(tokenId).

edges.reason: Constructor argument _root is assigned to the merkleRoot state variable.
Constructor argument _rings is assigned to the rings state variable.
setMerkleRoot parameter root is written into merkleRoot.
setRings parameter is written into the rings state variable.
setPaused parameter is written into the paused state variable.
Caller-supplied Merkle proof flows into claimRing where it is verified.
Caller-supplied tokenId flows into claimRing for lookup and transfer.
msg.sender drives the claim guard, the Merkle leaf and the NFT recipient inside claimRing.
msg.sender is the key used to read and later write the claimed mapping.
msg.sender is passed as the recipient of the transferFrom external call.
Caller-supplied tokenId is passed to the external ownerOf call.
Caller-supplied tokenId is passed to the external transferFrom call.
The ownerOf result stored in tokenOwner is used as the from-address of transferFrom.
Return value of the external ownerOf call is stored into the local tokenOwner variable.
The rings state variable supplies the target contract for the ownerOf external call.
The rings state variable supplies the target contract for the transferFrom external call.
merkleRoot is read by claimRing as the expected root for MerkleProof.verify.
paused is read at the start of claimRing to gate execution.
transferOwnership argument newOwner is forwarded into _setOwner.
_msgSender returns the msg.sender value to callers such as the onlyOwner modifier.
owner() returns the stored _owner state variable.
Constructor invokes _setOwner(_msgSender()) to initialise ownership.
_setOwner writes the new value into the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership calls _setOwner(address(0)) to clear ownership.
transferOwnership calls _setOwner(newOwner) to hand over ownership.
setMerkleRoot writes the merkleRoot state variable.
setRings writes the rings state variable.
setPaused writes the paused state variable.
claimRing marks claimed[msg.sender] = true before the external transfer.
claimRing performs an external call to the attacker-influenceable rings contract via ownerOf.
claimRing performs an external call to the attacker-influenceable rings contract via transferFrom.
The external transferFrom call executes after state bookkeeping, so a re-entrant callee could re-enter claimRing and re-evaluate the claimed mapping.
onlyOwner gates setMerkleRoot on owner() == _msgSender(), i.e. on the caller identity.
onlyOwner gates setRings on the caller identity.
onlyOwner gates setPaused on the caller identity.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership on the caller identity.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership on the caller identity.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _root only exists to seed merkleRoot and should be folded into the constructor function node.
Constructor parameter _rings only exists to seed rings and should be folded into the constructor function node.
setMerkleRoot parameter root is a transient input written straight into merkleRoot and should be folded into setMerkleRoot.
setRings parameter is a transient input written straight into rings and should be folded into setRings.
setPaused parameter is a transient input written straight into paused and should be folded into setPaused.
claimRing parameter proof is only consumed by the Merkle verification inside claimRing and should be folded into claimRing.
claimRing parameter tokenId is only consumed inside claimRing and should be folded into the claimRing function node.
transferOwnership parameter newOwner is only forwarded to _setOwner and should be folded into transferOwnership.
Local tokenOwner only holds the result of the external ownerOf call and should be folded into that unsafe_operation node.
